raids.lore: Just beyond this now abandoned ruin lies a dug out nest crawling with infantile Grootslangs. If left to mature, these newborn creatures will grow powerful enough to decimate the swamp.
raids.prep: To take on the Nest of the Grootslangs, you must first assemble a party of 4 players. Each must be at least Combat Level 54 and have completed The Worm Holes in their account. The entrance to the Raid is inside the ruined temple in the mountains on the northwestern edge of Olux Swamp.

rooms.d: Hold the platform for 60 seconds. In this room, there will be a "slimey platform" that a player needs to stand on and hold.
Hold and defend the tower for 60 seconds. In this room, there are 5 patches in the ground marked with yellow, blue, black, gray, and red wool.

Upon starting the puzzle, the player must look at the 5 set of colors that appears in the wall on the left. The player must then use the cannon to shoot the colors on the ceiling using that set of colors, ordered left to right.
This parkour is similar to the one in the Undergrowth Ruins, with there being diagonal slime pads that can provide a good bounce. There will be slime blocks on the walls which are used to direct you.
In this room, killing the Encroaching Tunneler rewards 1 Slimey Goo. Once 10 Slimey Goo have been added to the tower, you can progress.
Traverse through the tunnel, destroying rocks in between the path. In this room, there will be a Heavy Hammer in front of a tunnel.
Slay minibosses to raise up platforms. In this room, there will be 4 minibosses that must be killed.

raids.lore: Thought only to be a myth, this legendary structure acts as a nexus for the Realm of Light's power. Somewhere in its enigmatic halls lies Orphion, the physical manifestation of Light itself.
raids.prep: To challenge the Nexus of Light, you must assemble a party of 4 players. Each must be at least Combat Level 79, and have completed the The Realm of Light (Quest) in their account. The entrance to the Raid is inside the Nexus of Light's palace, on the northeastern edge of The Realm of Light.

rooms.d: Hold the tower for 60 seconds. There is a tower in the center of the room, surrounded by 6 "light crystals".
The miniboss section is found straight ahead. The Athanatic Witness must be killed in order to get 2 Light Crystals.
The parkour section is found to the left. Players in this section are given +9,999 2nd spell cost, rendering their movement spell unusable.
The puzzle section is found to the right. Players start off in the center of the room and must defend themselves from incoming Decay Atriums coming from above.
Guide the crystal holder. Upon entering this room, there will be a Light Crystal that the party needs to purify.
Escort your party to the Overseer, unlocking the Checkpoints. Upon entering this room, the party is presented by a Light Crystal.

raids.lore: A sight to behold, this enormous statue has resided in the Canyon of the Lost for as long as history can tell. Its magic permeates throughout the entire canyon, making it nigh-impossible to navigate.
raids.prep: To take on The Canyon Colossus, you must assemble a party of 4 players. Each must be at least Combat Level 95, and have completed The Breaking Point in their account. The entrance to the Raid is inside the body of the Colossus on the southeastern edge of the Canyon of the Lost.

rooms.d: Hold the Upper and Lower platforms for 60 seconds. In this room, there are 2 platforms, an upper and lower one.
Use water on overflowing lava to raise platforms. In this room, there is a small pond and 5 lava flows.
Find and reach the maze's exit. The party begins at the center of a large maze, with 4 possible paths marked with Blue, Yellow, Red, and Green carpets.
Wake the ancient stone golem. The party starts in a pocket of land surrounded by the canyon with an Inert Stone Golem.
Elder Astal has 5 HP and must be defended from meteors that get launched from the left and right. A player can step into the sigil behind Astal to start defending him.

Found on the outer left path, a miniboss called the Primeval Machine will jump down from a ledge near the Colossus and must be killed in order to activate a Binding Sigil. It fights similarly to other golem-like protectors and does various actions such as throwing rocks at players, performing heaping swings with its hammer, and simply hitting nearby players with it as well if it is within range.

Found on the outer right path, several boulders will roll towards the entrance to this section. An Invigorating Flame must be taken to complete this sub-challenge, which will make the holder unable to use spells or abilities and will negate any mobility identifications.

Found on the inner left path, a player needs to make their way up the Colossus' right hand. An Invigorating Flame must be taken to complete this sub-challenge, which will make the holder unable to use spells or abilities and will negate any mobility identifications.

Found on the inner right path, a miniboss called the Agate Axon must be killed in order to activate a Binding Sigil. The sub-challenge is started upon approaching its dormant state and dealing damage to it.

raids.lore: This recluse gap in reality has laid unknown to all but a few for an immeasurable amount of time. Within its walls lies a colossal hole in the barrier between realms, and within that hole lies a metaphysical entity responsible for the creation of the Void Holes that scatter the Silent Expanse.
raids.prep: To take on The Nameless Anomaly, you must first assemble a party of 4 players. Each must be at least Combat Level 103 and have completed A Journey Further. The entrance to the Raid is at the border between the Toxic Wastes and Void Valley, near The Gateway to Nothing.

rooms.d: Destroy the Void Holes within 120s! The Flooding Canyon is a circular-shaped room dotted with many floating Malefic Void Rifts hovering in place midair.
Hold the stump for 60s. In the center of the Sunken Grotto is a large tree stump.
Gather the Light! At the entrance to the Nameless Cave (and also the instruction room for this challenge), a small, blue light will hover above the ground to the left of the cave entrance.
Offer souls to the altar to enter the tree. Upon entering the room, players will be on a small beach on the edge of a still gray ocean, and above them will loom the gigantic Weeping Soulroot Tree.

On the left of the Giant Void Hole is a large pit with two separate parkours on the left and right of the pit, and a smaller parkour leading to the middle of the pit with a closed Void Hole below it. At the end of the other two parkours are pedestals, and once both pedestals have been interacted with, the Void Hole in the center of the parkour will open.
On the left of the Giant Void Hole is a red, bloody path. At the end of the path is a miniboss called the Dendrite Drifter.
On the right of the Giant Void Hole is a small black chasm with rocks floating in it. Void Eggs rest on each rock.

On the right of the Giant Void Hole is a large open area with two Malformed Void Hole minibosses. When entering the room, killing the void hole that spawns on the right and further back to the player will grant you the fourth Void Matter.

After all of the other four Void Matters have been deposited into the Giant Void Hole, the Void Holes will destabilize, spawning enemies faster while now being able to be damaged in order to progress the waves. When the Despairing Crawler spawns, it will be temporarily invulnerable until it conjures a Void Hole, and holds it as a shield.

raids.lore: Home to the Queen, this vast palace is the very heart of Fruma. It is filled with luxuries for Her Majesty to enjoy, for just like the province itself, it exists only to please her.
raids.prep: To take on The Wartorn Palace, you must first assemble a party of 4 players. Each must be at least Combat Level 119 and must have completed Apotheosis in their account. The character must also have access to the Fruma Province, which is traditionally unlocked by completing A Journey Home.

rooms.d: Collect the Sonic Amplifier! To begin the challenge, one player must go up the balcony to collect the "Sonic Amplifier", hereby referred to as the Wielder.
Fight through the palace rooms! Before each door, the party is given a choice between two of the elements ().
Slay the Knightmare by destroying its shields atop the statue. The Statuary Hall takes place in a chamber of the Palace with a statue of Her Majesty.
Defend the guards and close the rifts! This room features two buildings with pools below and a garden on top.
Rip out the artifact to break the sigil. The room is adorned with red spiraling sigils with a platform at the center, wedged is a spear called Bane of Binding, or simply the Artifact.

gambits.d: You cannot heal more than 10% max health over 1 second.
Main Attacks now cost 5 mana to use.
For each 1% health you lack, make your attacks 1% weaker.
For every 2 mobs killed, reduce your received healing by 10% for 10 seconds.
Cannot use more than 3 consumables throughout the raid.
Your attacks cannot deal more than 30% of a mob's max health per hit.
Lose 3% of your current max health every 25 seconds while in a challenge room.
You do 90% less damage to mobs that are 3 blocks or less away from you.
Hitting a mob 30 times over 3s will grant it 75% resistance to your attacks for 0.5s.
You have -1 less Raid Buff choice.
Every hit you take will deal at least 5% of your max health as damage.
Your mana can only regenerate by up to +10 per second.
For every 1% mana you have above 40% of your max, increase your spells' mana costs by 1%.
Your spells will misfire every 15 spells, instead casting the 2nd spell from your class.
You do 90% less damage to mobs that are 12 blocks or more away from you.
Your spells cost at least 20 mana.
Each time you die, deal -15% damage for the rest of the raid.
After being airborne for 3 seconds, you are unable to gain health in any way. This effect persists for 5 seconds after landing.
Taking damage additionally deals 2% more damage for every second since last being hit. (Max 40%)
You lose 2% of your current HP per second after 6 seconds of not dealing damage.
When a player within 6 blocks of you takes damage, you also take 25% of that damage.

lootrun.intro: Lootrunning is an activity for endgame players that involves looting a procedural series of Caves and challenges, primarily to acquire Mythics, Emeralds, and other valuable items. Players can join the activity for free by speaking to the Lootrun Chief inside the Silverbull Trading Company Headquarters east of Cinfras; after signing up, a lootrun can be started at one of the Lootrun Camps scattered around the endgame regions of Wynncraft.

beacons.note: Flying chests spawn around the player, a few seconds after the challenge is completed. Like the rewards chest for non-Spelunk challenges, the next Beacon offerings won't show up until the flying chests are all opened (or abandoned by moving sufficiently far away).

Aqua Beacons add +1/§b+2§r tiers to the next Beacon you choose. Taking successive Aqua Beacons will stack the effect for the following set of Beacon offerings (e.g. taking two unboosted Aqua Beacons in a row will have the same effect as if you had taken a §bGreatly Empower§red Aqua Beacon, and taking three or more in a row will max out the tier of your next Beacon chosen). Aqua Beacons themselves are not affected by a prior Aqua Beacon. Dying after completing an Aqua Beacon challenge will remove any accumulated Aqua Beacon effect for your next set of Beacon offerings.

missions.d: After opening a Flying Chest, remove one of your Curses.
All Challenges now additionally spawn 2 Flying Chests after completion.
After opening 8 Flying Chests, choose 1 Boon out of 2 after your next challenge.
Every time you are offered 25 Items from Flying Chests, randomly get +3-3 Pulls, +1-1 Boon, +1-2 Curse, or +60-60s.
Gaining 2 Pulls will add +1 Flying Chests to completing your next Yellow Beacon. (Max 12)
Boons are now 50% more effective.
After getting a Curse, consume 1 Boon to gain +1 Pull, +2 extra per 50% Potency over 100% consumed.

Purple and Blue Beacons are obscured, but will always be Greatly Empowered.
Taking a Boon Type that you already have will grant +1 Pull per duplicate. Your boons will be reduced in Potency by 50% per duplicate type.

Getting offered a Purple Beacon gives +1 Curse. Purple Beacons now give twice as many Pulls.
